exercises.title: Custom middleware and the custom 404 of slide 11
exercises.problemHtml:
Build an app with:

  1. a logger middleware registered first that pushes METHOD URL (e.g. "GET /Hello") into the exported array logs and calls next();
  2. GET / → <b>My First</b> Express http server and GET /Hello → Hello, World!;
  3. a last middleware answering 404 with Sorry, that route doesn't exist. Have a nice day!.

Export module.exports = { app, logs }.

Requirements

  • Logger first, routes next, 404 last.
  • The logger must call next().
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Dựng app gồm:

  1. middleware logger đăng ký đầu tiên, đẩy METHOD URL (ví dụ "GET /Hello") vào mảng logs được export rồi gọi next();
  2. GET / → <b>My First</b> Express http server và GET /Hello → Hello, World!;
  3. middleware cuối cùng trả 404 với Sorry, that route doesn't exist. Have a nice day!.

Export module.exports = { app, logs }.

Yêu cầu

  • Logger trước, route sau, 404 cuối cùng.
  • Logger phải gọi next().

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A middleware does one of two things: ends the cycle (sends a response) or calls next(). Registered last, a plain middleware only runs when no route answered — that is the 404.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Middleware làm một trong hai việc: kết thúc chu trình (gửi response) hoặc gọi next(). Đăng ký cuối cùng, một middleware thường chỉ chạy khi không route nào trả lời — đó chính là 404.

exercises.title: The articles router of the slides: route("/") and route("/:id")
exercises.problemHtml:
Rebuild the articleRouter of the official slides (Slot 3.1, slides 40–47) and mount it on /articles. Export the app with module.exports = app.

RequestStatusText sent with res.send
GET /articles200Will send all the articles to you!
POST /articles (JSON body)201Will add the article: TITLE with details: TEXT and DATE
PUT /articles403PUT operation not supported on /articles
DELETE /articles200Deleting all articles
GET /articles/:id200Will send details of the article: ID to you!
POST /articles/:id403POST operation not supported on /articles/ID
PUT /articles/:id (JSON body)200Will update the article: ID with title: TITLE
DELETE /articles/:id200Deleting article: ID

Note the PUT on one article answers 200: the slide wrote res.write and then res.status(201), and run for real the client got 200 anyway — set the status once, before sending.

Requirements

  • const articleRouter = express.Router() with articleRouter.use(express.json()).
  • Two chains: articleRouter.route('/').get(…).post(…).put(…).delete(…) and the same on '/:id'.
  • app.use('/articles', articleRouter) and module.exports = app.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Dựng lại articleRouter của slide gốc (Slot 3.1, slide 40–47) và gắn nó ở /articles. Export app bằng module.exports = app.

RequestMãChữ gửi bằng res.send
GET /articles200Will send all the articles to you!
POST /articles (thân JSON)201Will add the article: TITLE with details: TEXT and DATE
PUT /articles403PUT operation not supported on /articles
DELETE /articles200Deleting all articles
GET /articles/:id200Will send details of the article: ID to you!
POST /articles/:id403POST operation not supported on /articles/ID
PUT /articles/:id (thân JSON)200Will update the article: ID with title: TITLE
DELETE /articles/:id200Deleting article: ID

Chú ý PUT một bài trả 200: slide viết res.write rồi mới res.status(201), chạy thật client vẫn nhận 200 — đặt mã một lần, trước khi gửi.

Yêu cầu

  • const articleRouter = express.Router() kèm articleRouter.use(express.json()).
  • Hai chuỗi: articleRouter.route('/').get(…).post(…).put(…).delete(…) và tương tự trên '/:id'.
  • app.use('/articles', articleRouter) và module.exports = app.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: express.Router() is a mini-app; route(path) lets you write a path once and chain one handler per verb — exactly the structure Express Generator expects in routes/. Mounting with a prefix keeps the router reusable.

This set has 6 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or by running the snippet on your own machine), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# ExpressJS slides: middleware types, Generator, semver and two traps — answer key

1. Which are the five types of Express middleware listed in the slides? (choose all)Năm loại middleware Express trong slide là? (chọn hết)
   Answer: a) Error-handling + b) Application-level + d) Built-in + e) Router-level + f) Third-party
   "Database-level" is not a middleware type; Mongoose hooks are a different thing.VI: "Database-level" không phải loại middleware; hook của Mongoose là chuyện khác.

2. How does Express recognise an error-handling middleware?Express nhận ra middleware xử lý lỗi bằng cách nào?
   Answer: b) It has four parameters (err, req, res, next)
   Arity 4 is the only signal Express looks at.VI: Số tham số bằng 4 là dấu hiệu duy nhất Express xét.

3. In a project made by Express Generator, which file actually creates the HTTP server and calls listen?Trong dự án tạo bằng Express Generator, tệp nào thật sự tạo HTTP server và gọi listen?
   Answer: d) bin/www
   app.js builds and exports the app; bin/www imports it and listens (npm start runs node ./bin/www).VI: app.js dựng và export app; bin/www import nó rồi listen (npm start chạy node ./bin/www).

4. "express": "^4.19.2" in package.json accepts…"express": "^4.19.2" trong package.json chấp nhận…
   Answer: d) any 4.x.x from 4.19.2 (new minor and patch versions)
   ^ allows minor + patch updates within the same major; ~ allows only patches.VI: ^ cho phép cập nhật minor + patch trong cùng major; ~ chỉ cho patch.

5. A POST sends JSON but the app never called express.json(). What is req.body?POST gửi JSON nhưng app chưa gọi express.json(). req.body là gì?
   Answer: c) undefined
   Express 4 does not parse bodies by itself; checked for real, title/text/date print as undefined.VI: Express 4 không tự đọc thân; chạy thật, title/text/date in ra undefined.

6. A handler calls res.write("…") and then res.status(201).end("…"). Which status does the client receive (checked on Express 4.19.2)?Handler gọi res.write("…") rồi res.status(201).end("…"). Client nhận mã nào (đã kiểm trên Express 4.19.2)?
   Answer: b) 200
   The first write sends the headers with the default 200; later status changes are too late.VI: Lần write đầu đã gửi header với mã mặc định 200; đổi mã sau đó là quá muộn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. a) Error-handling + b) Application-level + d) Built-in + e) Router-level + f) Third-party

    "Database-level" is not a middleware type; Mongoose hooks are a different thing.

    VI: "Database-level" không phải loại middleware; hook của Mongoose là chuyện khác.

  2. b) It has four parameters (err, req, res, next)

    Arity 4 is the only signal Express looks at.

    VI: Số tham số bằng 4 là dấu hiệu duy nhất Express xét.

  3. d) bin/www

    app.js builds and exports the app; bin/www imports it and listens (npm start runs node ./bin/www).

    VI: app.js dựng và export app; bin/www import nó rồi listen (npm start chạy node ./bin/www).

  4. d) any 4.x.x from 4.19.2 (new minor and patch versions)

    ^ allows minor + patch updates within the same major; ~ allows only patches.

    VI: ^ cho phép cập nhật minor + patch trong cùng major; ~ chỉ cho patch.

  5. c) undefined

    Express 4 does not parse bodies by itself; checked for real, title/text/date print as undefined.

    VI: Express 4 không tự đọc thân; chạy thật, title/text/date in ra undefined.

  6. b) 200

    The first write sends the headers with the default 200; later status changes are too late.

    VI: Lần write đầu đã gửi header với mã mặc định 200; đổi mã sau đó là quá muộn.
